title: App Mode: a graph with a form on top

questions.q: What are the four steps of the App Mode builder?
options: Select inputs, select outputs, preview, set the default view
questions.answer: Select inputs, select outputs, preview, set the default view

questions.q: In the lab, what does filling in the form change?
options: Only the chosen values, and no wires
questions.answer: Only the chosen values, and no wires
questions.why: The lab reports three changed values and zero changed wires.

questions.q: Can an App Mode user still get a validation error?
options: Yes, if a field allows a value that the node rejects
questions.answer: Yes, if a field allows a value that the node rejects
questions.why: The form does not change the node's limits. Our inference is that the same validation applies.

questions.q: Which setting is the better field for an end user?
questions.why: Expose what the user decides, and keep what the author decided. This is our recommendation.
